in_greek.name: Δέλλα
in_greek.long_meaning: A Greek name derived from the word 'δέλλω', which means 'to show', 'to reveal', or 'to make known'. The name Della in Greek could be derived from the root 'δέλλω' and would mean 'she who reveals' or 'she who shows'. Alternatively, it could be derived from the word 'δέλλη' which means 'delight'.
